title: God Is Love; His Mercy Brightens
description: God Is Love; His Mercy Brightens in Tonic Solfa to ST. OSWALD, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Bowring wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 114 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “God is Love”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. OSWALD; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: God is love; his mer-cy bright-ens All the path in which we rove; Bliss he wakes, and woe he light-ens; God is wis-dom, God is love.

lines: God is love; his mercy brightens
All the path in which we rove;
Bliss he wakes, and woe he lightens;
God is wisdom, God is love.
Chance and change are busy ever;
God is wisdom, God is love.
E'en the hour that darkest seemeth
From the gloom his brightness streameth,
God is wisdom, God is love.
God is wisdom, God is love.

licence: Public domain: John Bowring died in 1872.
credits: Words by John Bowring (1792–1872), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. OSWALD by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
